    public class Request {
        @InvocableVariable(required=true) public String email;

    @InvocableMethod(label='Match Contact by Email')
    public static List<Result> match(List<Request> requests) {
        List<Result> results = new List<Result>();
        
        // Collect unique normalized emails from requests
        Set<String> uniqueEmails = new Set<String>();
        for (Request req : requests) {
            if (String.isNotBlank(req.email)) {
                String normalized = req.email.trim().toLowerCase();
                uniqueEmails.add(normalized);
            }
        }
        
        // Map to store the best matching contact for each email
        Map<String, Id> emailToContactId = new Map<String, Id>();
        
        // Single SOQL query to fetch all relevant contacts
        if (!uniqueEmails.isEmpty()) {
            List<Contact> contacts = [
                SELECT Id, Email, CreatedDate
                FROM Contact
                WHERE LOWER(Email) IN :uniqueEmails
                ORDER BY CreatedDate ASC, Id ASC
            ];
            
            // Group by normalized email, keeping the first (earliest CreatedDate, lowest Id)
            for (Contact c : contacts) {
                String normalizedEmail = c.Email.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (!emailToContactId.containsKey(normalizedEmail)) {
                    emailToContactId.put(normalizedEmail, c.Id);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Build results in the same order as requests
        for (Request req : requests) {
            Result res = new Result();
            if (String.isNotBlank(req.email)) {
                String normalized = req.email.trim().toLowerCase();
                res.contactId = emailToContactId.get(normalized);
            } else {
                res.contactId = null;
            }
            results.add(res);
        }
        
        return results;
    }
}
